tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa las: tshe sgrub rgyun khyer gyi gdams pa rang gzhan gnyis la gces pa rdo rje snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈ na mo gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki nī hūm̐: tshe sgrub rgyun khyer man ngag la: mchog tu gces pa'i yig chung 'di: phyi rabs skal ldan rjes 'jug rnams: tshe nyams gso phyir nyams su longs: dad dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas: gang zhig nangs par sngar langs te: lus gnad rdo rje skyil krung bca': rlung ro lan gsum phyir dbyung la: tshe bdud sdig sgrib thon par bsam: de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya: snang ba mtha' yas spyan ras gzigs: pad+ma 'byung gnas man+dā ra: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol: ces pas gsol ba lan gsum btab: de nas skad cig dran rdzogs su: rang lus sgyu ma'i grong khyer 'di: gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa: rtse mo tshangs pa'i gnas su reg: rtse gcig gser gyi sa gzhir reg: 'od dang gzi brjid ldan par gsal: de yi lte bar rang nyid ni: rnam shes yi ge hrīḥdamar po: tsheg drag dang bcas 'od 'phro bsgom: ngag nas hrīḥzhes brjod pa yis: hrīḥlas 'od zer dmar po'i tshogs: hrīḥyig lta bur 'phros pa yis: phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs sras dang bcas: tshe yi lha la phog gyur cing: de dag thugs dam rgyud bskul nas: tshur byon hrīḥl thim pa yis: bkrag dang gzi mdangs ldan dmigs la: rlung byung dmigs pa tshur la bsdu: phyir dbyung hrīḥyig 'od zer 'phros: de dus hrīḥzhes bzlas par bya: brgya stong khri 'bum ci mang bya: skabs skabs rlung thun ci thub gzung: de nas thun mtshams bar skabs su: mi dmigs rgyas btab bsngo ba bya: 'di la rgyun du 'bad pa yis: 'grub pa'i mtshan ma 'di ltar 'byung: rang lus gser gyi rdo rjer gyur: nyi zla shar dang bdud rtsi 'thung: dri med gos gyon rgyan bzang btags: spo mthon steng phyin dar phyar dang: rol mo bsgrags dang chu chen brgal:

nam langs khrus byas la sogs pa'i: khyad par tshe 'phel ltas bzang 'byung: dam tshig gzhan la mi spel dang: nyams su len dus gsang ba gces: mi dge spang zhing dge ba'i las: ci 'grub bya dang khyad par du: 'chi nges tshe srog yang yang bslu: gzhan don byed pa'i skyes bu yis: nyams su len na 'di lta ste: thun gyi bar mtshams 'jog pa'i dus: rang lus gser gyi rdo rje de: gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sku: gcer bu dmar gsal rus rgyan can: phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag tshe bum 'dzin: stong gsum khengs pa gcig tu gsal: de yi ngang la ci bder bya: snang srid 'khor 'das chos rnams kun: rang bzhin dngos med mtha' bral ba: bcos bslad med pa'i ngang la bzhag: de ni man ngag dam pa 'o: sa ma ya: tshe sgrub rgyun khyer gyi gdams pa rdo rje'i snying po zhes bya ba las can gcig dang 'phrad par shog: rgya rgya rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: gter rgya: tshe sgrub rgyun khyer gyi gdams pa rdo rje'i snying po zhes bya ba/ gter ston rol pa ye shes rtsal gyis gter nas bton pa shu bhaṃ/// /
